proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11533 vāma gives Nepali bāũ, Ku. bāyõ and Hindi bāyā̃ left. The survey bay-/baw- and nasalized variants fit that left-hand family. Reviewed comparator: H baya “left” (f_gw67sfqxvoc3u). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
